goal: Audit explicit documentation against the callable implementation path.
initial_conditions: Fresh isolated virtual workspace containing only the listed fixtures.
observable_result: verdict; read documentation; read implementation; Exactly one submission must include nonempty explanation citing src/names.py and format_name; verdict is checked separately.

files.docs/names.md: The public format_name function trims whitespace and preserves capitalization.

steps.content: Read docs/names.md and src/names.py. Audit only explicit user-visible claims, following the implementation. Use inconclusive if evidence is unavailable. Call eval_submit exactly once with verdict match, mismatch or inconclusive and an explanation citing the claim, src/names.py and format_name; for a mismatch explain the actual behavior. Then briefly summarize.

checks.name: evidence
checks.basis: One explanation cites src/names.py and format_name, and submission is the final tool action. This is a mechanical evidence check, not a semantic proof of explanation quality.
